status.en: 217 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 24% fewer than the week before, most of them in Moscow, Kyiv and Kharkiv.
status.nb: 217 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 24 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Moskva, Kyiv og Kharkiv.

summary.en: Russia continues missile and sabotage attacks inside Ukraine, including a ballistic strike on Kyiv that killed one civilian and injured fourteen, and a fire near a weapons factory blamed on a Russia-run network. Ukrainian forces are conducting deep-strike missions up to 2,500 km, hitting a missile-battery plant in Yelets and a chemical plant in Voronezh, and are evacuating wounded soldiers by drone. A US-brokered ceasefire is now in effect in the occupied city of Oleshky, where residents previously survived on weeds. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Russland fortsetter missil- og sabotasjeangrep inne i Ukraina, inkludert et ballistisk angrep på Kyiv som drepte én sivil og såret fjorten, og en brann nær en våpenfabrikk som ble skylt på et Russland-styrt nettverk. Ukrainske styrker gjennomfører dype angrep på opptil 2 500 km, og treffer et missilbatterifabrikk i Yelets og et kjemisk anlegg i Voronezh, og evakuerer sårede soldater med drone. En amerikansk meklet våpenhvile er nå i kraft i den okkuperte byen Oleshky, hvor innbyggerne tidligere overlevde på ugress. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)
background.extract: On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine, starting the largest and deadliest war in Europe since World War II, in a major escalation of the existing war between the two countries that began when Russia attacked Ukraine in 2014. The fighting has caused hundreds of thousands of military casualties and tens of thousands of Ukrainian civilian casualties. Russian troops occupy roughly 20% of Ukraine. From a population of 41 million, about 8 million Ukrainians have been internally displaced and 6–7 million have fled the country, creating Europe's largest refugee crisis since World War II.
background.extractNb: Russlands invasjon av Ukraina 2022 begynte tidlig om morgenen 24. februar, da russiske styrker gjennomførte et stort angrep på Ukraina. Dette var en kraftig opptrapping av krigen i Ukraina, som har pågått siden 2014 og blant annet omfattet okkupasjon av Krym. Invasjonen har ført til titusenvis av døde på hver side, og ledet til Europas største flyktningkrise siden andre verdenskrig. Om lag 8 millioner ukrainere var internflyktninger i juni 2022, og over 8 millioner hadde flyktet fra landet i mai 2023.

posts.text:

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️️ 302,000 Russian soldiers killed or wounded by Ukrainian drones since January, Defense Ministry says.

The highest number of casualties Ukrainian drones inflicted on the Russian military was recorded in March, with almost 34,000 soldiers killed or irrecoverably wounded.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️️ Norway, Finland call Putin ahead of potential Abu Dhabi peace talks.

"The outcome of this war will have a direct impact on our and the broader European security. Ending the war requires direct discussions," said Finnish President Alexander Stubb.

posts.author: The Associated Press
posts.text:
Finland’s president and Norway’s prime minister spoke on phone with Russian President Putin, officials said.
The call was held to discuss the war and expected upcoming trilateral talks involving Russia, Ukraine and the U.S.

posts.text:

Russian attacks hit Kyiv's Southern Bridge, disrupting metro services, as well as a university campus, an administrative building, and medical centers.

posts.text:
⚡️️️️️️️New report tracks how Russia helps China build better drones.

The investigation found that Russian designs for rocket-launched drones likely shaped weapons China unveiled in 2025 and that Russian wind tunnels kept testing aircraft models for China's top arms maker after the invasion of Ukraine.

posts.text:
⚡️️️️️️️Local ceasefire in besieged Oleshky begins, Ukrainian, Russian officials say.

A ceasefire to allow humanitarian aid to enter the Russian occupied city began as Russian forces launched ballistic missiles at other parts of Ukraine.

posts.text:
⚡️️️️️️️Update: Russia launches 2nd wave of ballistic missiles at Kyiv. 

Explosions rocked the city again at around 3:30 a.m., according to reporters on the ground. Earlier in the night, Russian missiles hit a university and city medical centers, killing at least one person and injuring 10 others.

posts.text:
⚡️Ukraine reportedly strikes Russian ammunition depot in occupied Luhansk Oblast.

Ukrainian forces attacked an ammunition depot in occupied Luhansk Oblast, setting off explosions at the site overnight on Oct. 27, monitoring channels reported.
